subject: Evidence & log granularity asks for Dedicated BYOK pilot - triage and owners
messages:
From: Lumen Health Security <security@lumenhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Evidence & log granularity asks for Dedicated BYOK pilot

Hi Marissa / Kimberly,

Thanks again for the demo earlier — Lumen is moving forward with a small Dedicated BYOK pilot and we need to nail down the compliance evidence and logging surface before kickoff. Attached is a condensed spreadsheet of asks (Lumen_Audit_Questions_v3.xlsx). Top-line asks: 

- Per-request / per-token audit records (timestamps, requester id, model version, route) for 90-day window.
- KMS key rotation logs (who rotated, key id, rotation time) and proof of custody during rotations.
- SSO session events (login, token renewal, SAML assertions) tied to user ids.
- Evidence path for SOC2 controls we asked about (mapping to your controls).

We're planning a compliance review on Sep 6; can you confirm what of the above is currently available from Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private deploys, and what will require product/engineering work? Also indicate an estimated ETA for a deliverable we could include in the review.

Thanks,
Alyssa Chen
Lumen Health — InfoSec

Attachment: Lumen_Audit_Questions_v3.xlsx (spreadsheet, 42KB)
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-23T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & log granularity asks for Dedicated BYOK pilot

Hi Alyssa — thanks for the clear list and the spreadsheet. Attaching an initial mapping for what we can commit to for the Sep 6 review.

Quick summary for Lumen:
- Hosted: we already emit detailed request traces (trace id, model, token counts) but not per-token content. Hosted customers cannot provide BYOK.
- Dedicated: we can expose per-request metadata and comprehensive KV+rotation logs; per-token content capture is an explicit product ask that requires a small runtime change and a policy decision.
- Private (VPC/on-prem): full custody evidence path is possible but we need an integration plan for customer KMS telemetry.

Internal owners suggested: Jonas — runtime audit/logging spike + perf impact assessment; Kimberly — compliance evidence mapping & SOC2 correlation; Grace — customer kickoff and pilot SOW language.

Can we do a quick sync Wed (Aug 25) to split the work and produce a one-page deliverable for Sep 6?

Best,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0192

Attachment: initial_mapping_for_lumen.pdf (created from internal notes)
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-24T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Evidence & log granularity asks for Dedicated BYOK pilot

+1 to the owners. Technical clarifications / initial plan: 

- "Per-request metadata" today includes request id, model name/version, route id, token counts, latency, and GPU node id. We do not persist per-token plaintext by default (privacy/regulatory reasons) — adding that would require both storage changes and opt-in controls.
- KMS rotation logs: for Dedicated we already record rotation events in our key-management audit stream, but the event shape needs to include the "operator" field and an immutable rotation id. I'll scope the change.
- SSO session events: we emit login/refresh events to our auth telemetry; mapping to customer user id in Dedicated requires a minimal change to include tenant scoping.

I'll open SERV-1234 (spike) to enumerate required schema changes and perf impact; estimate 5 engineer-days for a minimal, gated MVP for Dedicated (no per-token capture) and 3 more days for the KMS operator fields. If Lumen must have per-token content for 90 days, that's a larger effort — storage and retention policy + legal review.

Linking the draft ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/SERV-1234

-Jonas
